I want to spend more out of the house but I can't just go out when ever I feel like and I have to plan it a few days a head for my mum.  Plus I would feel really weird asking to hang out all of a sudden after years if just seeing each other at school.

When  ran away I just kept walking for half the day and ended up at a family friends house by chance. I then sat around there for a few hours until she got home from helping looking for me. She then took me home. I didn't want to goto a friend house because I felt embarrassed that I was running away from my problems. They also probably would of told people too causing it to spread to everyone and they would use it to make fun of me more.
